scenes.caption: Fruitcats — knock out all 9 of their hearts
scenes.say: Fruitcats is a card game about fruit-flavoured cats. Each side has a Hero Cat with nine hearts, and you win by knocking out all nine of theirs. The game walks you through your first match, so you can just press play — but here is the whole thing in a minute.

scenes.caption: Treats are the money — every planted card is worth 1
scenes.say: Cards cost Treats, and Treats are made from cards. You bury two of your six face down, and each becomes one Treat, whatever it cost. So bury the expensive ones and keep the cheap cards to play.

scenes.caption: Spend a Treat to put a cat on the table
scenes.say: The number in a card's corner is its price. Spend the Treats and the cat comes down onto your side. It arrives sleepy, so it can attack from the next round.

scenes.caption: One action each, back and forth
scenes.say: You each do one thing at a time, back and forth — so you cannot line up three attacks in a row, and nothing you do goes unanswered.

scenes.caption: Attack their cat, or their Hero Cat to take a heart
scenes.say: Once a cat is awake, click it and click what it should hit. Their cat, and the two trade damage. Their Hero Cat, and a heart goes out — that card lands in their hand, so falling behind gives you more to play with.

scenes.caption: Play it at fruitcats.viamochi.com
scenes.say: Nine hearts, and the game is yours. Press play at fruitcats dot viamochi dot com — the walkthrough will take it from there.
